subject: Banking
title: Decentralized Credit on Blockchain
description: A 60-second lesson on Decentralized Credit on Blockchain.

hook.text: DeFi lending platforms issue loans without banks or credit checks. A smart contract replaces the loan officer.

buildup.text: Borrowers post cryptocurrency as collateral. The smart contract automatically liquidates it if the loan-to-value ratio.

discovery.text: DeFi lending reached $50 billion in 2021. No credit score needed. Just collateral and code.

twist.text: DeFi requires over-collateralization. You need $150 in crypto to borrow $100.

climax.text: DeFi removed the bank but not the inequality. Lending without credit scores still requires assets most people don't.

punchline.text: No bank, no credit score, no bias. But you need $150 to borrow $100.

quiz.question: What is the main limitation of DeFi lending?
options: It requires over-collateralization, helping only those who already have assets
